cards.title: What’s Really in Your Skincare?
cards.body:
“I’ve been chasing good skin for decades.”

When I was a teenager, I thought the answer to acne was “more products.” 
I tried all my friends recommendations, and everything I could find to make it go away.
The more they stung, the more I believed they were working.

Spoiler: they didn’t. My skin got redder, it burned sometimes, it was dry and it got more  sensitive every month.

In my 30s, it was tennis tournaments on the weekends and joint pain on Mondays.
Every balm I tried smelled like a chemical factory and only numbed the ache for a few hours.

Then menopause hit… and my skin felt like paper.
Dermatitis showed up on my hands and arms, and steroid creams became my new “must-have.”

But the relief never lasted, and my skin just got weaker.

One night, I realized I’d been repeating the same mistake since I was 15, trusting ingredients I can’t even pronounce, instead of really caring for my skin.

I have a beautiful family and I didn’t wanted to repeat my mistakes over again.
 
I wanted to find better solutions for them and for me. 

So I started reading labels, researching natural ingredients, and tossing anything I couldn’t pronounce.

That’s when I stumbled across a Frøya ad on my Facebook page.

I figured, why not try?

🌼 The Chamomile balm stopped my daughter’s and son’s acne flare-ups.
🌸 The Calendula one worked better on my dermatitis than every other weird balm i’ve tried before.
🌿 And the Camphor balm? It’s been a lifesaver for the grown-ups pain.

Now I keep a set in my bag, in the bathroom, and in the car 😂

And I can’t shut up about it

I’ve shared this with my yoga friends, the other moms at school pickup, even my neighbor and her sore knee.

It’s not just skincare it’s the peace of mind that I’m giving my family something safe, natural, and effective.

And honestly? I wish I’d found it 20 years ago.

I'm not here to sell you anything. I'm here to walk you through a day of small, honest habits... the ones that actually cleared my acne.

I run a skincare blog, so people expect me to lead with products. I'd rather lead with the day.

Morning: before I touch my phone, five slow breaths and a minute of just being present. It sounds too small to matter for skin. It isn't. A calm nervous system means less cortisol, and less cortisol means less oil and inflammation.

Through the day: I stopped swallowing every hard feeling and let my emotions actually move... the stress I used to bury always resurfaced on my jaw. And I ate for my gut, less processed, more real food, because your face is a mirror of what's happening inside.

Evening: I protect my sleep like it's medicine, because it is. Your skin does most of its repair between 10pm and 4am... miss that window and no product can buy it back.

And woven through all of it, the smallest layer: a waterless balm from the Arctic, made from botanicals so concentrated they survive one of the harshest climates on earth. Built on the old Viking idea that what's natural doesn't just calm your skin, it calms your life.

100% natural. No chemicals, no water, no fillers.

I saw the first change by day 9, and within a month my acne was gone. It supports the skin; it doesn't do the living for you. That part's still yours.
